answer: A dynamic opportunity-cost bond, backed by staking collateral and released only after a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, functions as a bridge that locks each identity's future reward. The protocol couples this with a subgame-perfect punishment matrix imposing slashing penalties calibrated to make any Sybil multiplication's expected utility strictly negative, generating a ripple of deterrence that forces the system into a strict Nash equilibrium is a mirror of the honest profile.
